verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples. A developer portal exists, but the probe found it serves only a JavaScript app shell with no observable try-it console or runnable samples, and every OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. Patent Center's 'Training mode' is an interactive filing simulation, not an API reference, so it earns no credit. As a government service with real APIs, this axis applies, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
